message_variants.message:
Subject: A Warm Invitation to Weekend Brunch at Bella Italia

Body: Dear Guest, we invite you to experience a refined dining experience this weekend. Our chefs have prepared a specialty meal featuring fluffy pancakes drizzled with maple syrup and topped with fresh, aromatic berries.

Bella Italia offers a rustic Italian trattoria ambiance where you can enjoy authentic Italian flavors in the heart of Karachi. We look forward to hosting you and your loved ones for this delicious brunch.

Regards,
Team Bella Italia
Authentic Italian flavors in the heart of Karachi
